subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Is the July 6 live capture enough to promote a live Discord repair/harness now, or should this wait for maintainer-run current-main reproduction first?
rationale: The bug is credible and high-impact, but this read-only pass did not reproduce current main and source inspection does not isolate a narrow root cause for a safe autonomous fix.

options.title: Hold for maintainer live repro
options.body: Keep this issue open with maintainer review until a current-main Discord live run or transport harness captures the stuck reconnect path and root cause.

options.title: Promote live-harness repair
options.body: Queue a scoped repair only if maintainers can provide or authorize the live Discord harness needed to prove 1005/1006 recovery without process restart.

options.title: Ship operator fallback first
options.body: Treat channel-scoped start/stop or reconnect UX as the first deliverable while leaving automatic self-reconnect as follow-up reliability work.

recommendation.title: Hold for maintainer live repro
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open with maintainer review until a current-main Discord live run or transport harness captures the stuck reconnect path and root cause.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-history owner for the Discord gateway lifecycle files and recent reconnect hardening.
